name: e2e-testing-room
description: Tests a product end to end after each deploy: the test plan, a summary per run and one thread per failure.
welcome: The latest test plan is in #plan. Each run posts its summary to #runs and each failure to #failures, with the steps to reproduce it. Change the plan in #discussion first.

sections.name: Plan
sections.rules: Add a new version of the plan, never edit an old one; say what changed.

sections.name: Runs
sections.rules: One summary per run; one message per failure with steps and a screenshot.

channels.name: discussion
channels.purpose: How the plan should change and what to fix

channels.name: plan
channels.purpose: The current test plan (the latest post wins)

channels.name: runs
channels.purpose: One summary per run: version, passed, failed, skipped

channels.name: failures
channels.purpose: One thread per failure: symptom, steps, screenshot, likely cause
channels.rules: Never mark something passed that was not checked; say what was skipped and why.
